messages:
Alex: Heads up: ran into a trio of related DX bugs around embeddings + rerank while onboarding a partner. Posting notes here before opening issues.

Alex: Bug A) Batched embeddings sometimes return inconsistent vector lengths within the same response. Example sanitized snippet from staging: 
```json
{"model":"open-embed-1","data":[{"embedding":[0.1,0.2,...,0.3],"id":"a"},{"embedding":[0.01,0.02,0.03],"id":"b"}]}
```
(one item only had 3 dims). We expect 768 for every item.

Alex: Bug B) Rerank helper parity: JS helper auto-truncates long candidate docs to avoid 413s; Python helper raises an error. This leads to different ranking outputs between SDKs for the same input set.

Alex: Bug C) Retry stacking: our staging logs show duplicate embedding calls when we hit 429s. Looks like both transport-level and SDK-level retry layers are retrying non-idempotent requests. Cost spike observed.

Priya: Do you have the raw request body and full response? Curious if this is a server-side sharding/replica issue or a client packing bug.

Alex: Sent the sanitized full response in thread. Request was batched: input array of 5 short strings. Also saw a 502 around the same time which correlates.

Sam: For parity, we should align behavior across SDKs. Proposal: share a small "request validator/normalizer" in devex-utils that both SDKs depend on. Behavior: default to safe-truncate with a warn, plus a strict mode that raises. Add unit tests that assert identical outputs for same inputs across SDKs.

Maya: For retries, change: transport retry should only handle network/connect (e.g., ENETUNREACH, ETIMEDOUT). SDK retry should handle transient server-side (429/5xx) with idempotency checks. Also add a top-level attempt dedupe header so proxies can avoid double-processing non-idempotent requests.

Alex: Repro steps I used: 1) curl POST /v1/embeddings with body {"model":"open-embed-1","input":["s1","s2","s3","s4","s5"]} 2) compare embedding lengths in response array

Alex: curl example (staging):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-1","input":["a","b","c","d","e"]}'
```

Priya: Could be streaming/decoder truncation on one shard. Can you share the exact response content? Also which SDK versions?

Alex: JS 2.3.0, Python 1.8.1. Full response (sanitized) pasted. There was a short lived 502 before the batch finished.

Sam: I'll own the SDK parity change. Plan: create a small spec (max input bytes, normalize/truncate rules), add a shared test vector corpus, implement same behavior in JS & Python, release patch. Also add integration test that sends batched request to staging and compares SDK outputs.

Maya: I'll update the retry RFC: explicitly separate transport retry config and SDK retry; disable transport retry for POSTs to generate/embeddings/rerank by default. Add opt-in to re-enable. Also add instrumentation to surface doubled requests (same idempotency token) in logs.

devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-1132: "Batched embeddings shape mismatch" assigned to Alex.

Alex: One more note: rerank response shape changed keys in a patch last week (scores -> rank_scores) and our internal client broke. We need stable response contracts or a version/compat header.

Priya: I'll add gateway compatibility mapping for the key rename for one release cycle and add schema checks to the API CI job.

Sam: Tests to add: 1) batched embeddings shape invariant 2) SDK parity for truncation/validation 3) response key mapping 4) retry idempotency smoke test.

Maya: I'll put a temporary config flip in staging to disable transport retries and watch token usage. If we see doubling drop, we'll keep it off until fixed.

Alex: For immediate mitigation, I'll pin JS SDK to 2.3.0 where we observed auto-truncate and add an assert that vector length == 768 in our ingestion pipeline so we fail fast.

Priya: Thanks for flagging. If you can open the sample repo with the failing test cases, I can pair on the gateway shim.

Sam: I'll open the JS PR with the normalization util and link test vectors.

Maya: I'll post the retry RFC update later today.

Alex: Appreciate it all :thumbsup:
